title: Jonny Strickle Discusses Strategic Capital Allocation at the 2026 KBW Insurance Conference
summary: Jonny Strickle discusses Pelagos’ approach to strategic capital allocation, market conditions, underwriting partnerships, optionality and growth at the 2026 KBW Insurance Conference.
body_markdown:
Earlier this month, Jonny Strickle, Group Managing Director at Pelagos Insurance Capital, joined Meyer Shields of Keefe, Bruyette & Woods at the 2026 KBW Insurance Conference for a wide-ranging discussion on Pelagos’ approach to strategic capital allocation and navigating evolving market conditions.


The conversation explored:


- How optionality and access to differentiated sources of risk support Pelagos’ approach to capital allocation
- The importance of agility in allocating capital as market conditions and opportunities evolve
- The role of underwriting partnerships in broadening access to risk and supporting diversification and growth
- Pelagos’ approach to managing volatility and responding to changing conditions across the insurance and reinsurance markets
